items.summary: Reviewer disposition: reject failbunny.com implementation because analytics and site-specific outcome evidence are absent. Route only two bounded SEO implementations—saveusfarms.com and stinkyleftfoot.com—because they have measurable search baselines and reversible scopes. No revenue, ROI, causal-lift, launch-readiness, or production-readiness claims are supported. A third actionable candidate was not available: other surfaced candidates are blocked by active measurement/review, infrastructure, launch-readiness, or missing telemetry. Domain-manager must attach failbunny.com analytics and baseline evidence by 2026-10-09; escalate unresolved evidence to the owner by 2026-10-09T17:00Z.
